summary: Money Rain overlay + map PreviewCard hooks, tested at 390x844 on the public URL as demo@amass.africa. A MutationObserver init script (/app/tests/i81_helpers.py) logged every money-rain-* mount with its start/end time, the route, and its pointer-events. Backend passed 9/9: test_map_first_gating 6/6 plus a new test_map_markers_hooks 3/3. All 143 markers carry the hook fields. Locked markers have images=null, approx=true, and no location/agent_* keys. Frontend checks that passed: (A) A pin tap shows money-rain-brief at once (12 notes, gone after 2085ms) and the card opens. Re-tapping the same pin 3x, zoom in/out and locate did not rain. A different pin rains once. A normal (non-forced) click on preview-close goes through while the overlay plays (pointer-events none). (B) The /saved-properties card gives one brief rain. Direct /property/{id} gives one brief rain. Toggling fav-btn twice gives no rain. Map 'View home' opens ?rained=1 with no second rain. (C) Unlock of a locked 40 MASS pin: no rain before confirm, then exactly one subtle rain. The property page then opens with rained=1 and no brief rain. Unlocked pin 'View home' gives no rain. A FIX unlock on /fixa gives no rain. (D) MASS explorer purchase: no rain on tap, then one celebrate rain (3647ms) when the success sheet appears. FIX purchase: no rain. /payment/callback?ref=bogus shows 'Payment pending' with no rain. (E) Make offer gives one subtle rain. Checkout gives one celebrate rain (3654ms) plus the 'Order placed!' badge. (F) Finance apply gives one subtle rain. Pending detail gives none. Patched to approved: 1st visit gives celebrate, 2nd visit none. (G) Inspection request gives one subtle rain. Requested detail gives none. Patched to scheduled: 1st visit subtle, 2nd none. FIXA booking gives one subtle rain. PreviewCard (locked ₦420M): ai 'AI value ₦440M · 5% under', proof '40 views', amenities, unlocks 'Unlock: +4 photos · full address · agent contact', place 'Duplex · Lekki · approx.' (no street address), height 407px. The unlocked pin shows no preview-unlocks or preview-amenities. Bugs found: (1) reduced motion is broken: it renders 12 notes parked at y≈850-905, at or below the bottom edge of the 844px viewport, so they are mostly invisible; (2) the property page rains on a non-existent id; (3) no aria-hidden on web; (4) a reload of /payment/callback for an already-paid ref replays the celebration. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

ui_bugs.issue: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, a pin tap renders 12 notes instead of 5. They are static but sit at translateY 851-905px, at or below the bottom of the 844px viewport, so the user sees almost nothing. The overlay does unmount in 1144ms. RCA: Rain mounts fresh on every play. useReducedMotion() (src/ui/Feedback.tsx:230) starts false and resolves async, while the notes useMemo([]) at MoneyRain.tsx:128 freezes count and fall on that first false render. The Banknote then switches to the reduce branch with the non-reduced fall distance (≈0.92-1.1 × height). Fix: use reanimated's synchronous useReducedMotion, or read reduce once in MoneyRainProvider and pass it to Rain as a prop, or add reduce to the useMemo deps.

/property/bogus-id-123 shows 'We couldn't find this property' AND plays money-rain-brief. The rain call at app/property/[id].tsx:105 fires inside the mount effect, before or independent of getProperty succeeding. It should fire only after the property loads (e.g. in reload() on success). The same applies to network errors.

Dedup for pay:{ref} is in-memory only. Reloading /payment/callback?ref=<already-paid ref> (web refresh, back nav, or a stale deep link on a cold start) replays money-rain-celebrate. Use rainOncePersisted('celebrate', `pay:${ref}`) in both callback.tsx:52 and TokenPurchaseScreen.tsx:155.

issues: On web the bottom Sheet (an RN Modal, src/ui/Sheet.tsx:48) covers the lower half of the celebrate/subtle rain. On native, an RN Modal renders in its own window above the root view, so the rain from MoneyRainProvider (in the root tree, zIndex 9000) will be fully hidden behind the sheet and its scrim. The same applies to the gorhom BottomSheetModal host, which sits above MoneyRainProvider in _layout.tsx:121. Consider FullWindowOverlay (iOS) or rendering the rain inside the Modal, or start the rain when the sheet closes.

preview-amenities is numberOfLines=1. With 4 long amenities ('Swimming Pool · 24/7 Security · Gym · Solar Power · Built 2024') the 'Built YYYY' part is cut off at 390px width. Consider 3 amenities or putting Built first.

An unknown reference shows 'Payment pending … balance will update automatically', which is misleading for a ref that doesn't exist. It should show 'failed / not found' when the status endpoint returns 404.

react_native_issues.issue: The overlay root has accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants', but react-native-web renders no aria-hidden, so screen readers on web read the note texts ('₦1000 CENTRAL BANK OF NIGERIA'…). Add aria-hidden={true} (RN 0.7x+/RNW supports it). Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/MoneyRain.tsx:160

action_items: HIGH: Fix reduced-motion money rain (MoneyRain.tsx:125-151). Get reduce synchronously (reanimated useReducedMotion or a provider-level value) so that count=5 and fall = 0.22-0.52 × height are used. Today the notes park off-screen at the bottom.
MEDIUM: In app/property/[id].tsx, rain the brief rain only after api.getProperty(id) succeeds, not in the mount effect (a bogus id or an error state currently rains).
LOW: Add aria-hidden to the MoneyRain root View for web a11y.
LOW: Persist the pay:{ref} celebration (rainOncePersisted) so callback reloads or deep-link replays don't celebrate again.

LOW/native: Verify on a device that celebrate/subtle rain is visible above RN Modal sheets (purchase-success, finance-success, inspection-success). If it is hidden, render via FullWindowOverlay or inside the Sheet.

LOW: rainOncePersisted writes the 'seen' key before rain(). If rain() is dropped because a brief/subtle rain is still playing, the approved/scheduled state is marked seen and never celebrates. Write the key only when rain() returns true (or let persisted calls bypass busy).
LOW: Rain's useEffect depends on the inline onDone (MoneyRain.tsx:88/157), so any provider re-render restarts the hide timer. Use a stable callback (useCallback with the id, or a ref).
critical_code_review_comments: MoneyRain.tsx:128 notes useMemo([]) captures reduce=false on the first render (root cause of the reduced-motion bug).
property/[id].tsx:105 rain fires regardless of load success.

Observed: for celebrate, a 0-1ms duplicate money-rain-celebrate DOM node is mounted and immediately replaced (buy-tokens and callback), and on the callback after a reload the celebration ended early (1757ms vs ~3650ms), probably a provider subtree remount during auth hydration. Not visible as a double overlay, but worth checking that MoneyRainProvider never remounts.

Dedup / busy logic is correct: same key ignored for 2.5s, once is honored, and celebrate replaces. All call sites rain only after an awaited server success (unlock charged>0 && featureKey==='property', paymentStatus 'paid' && MASS, checkout res.order_id, offer, finance, inspection, fixaBook).

rca_of_issue: Reduced motion: useReducedMotion is async (initial false) and the Rain component mounts fresh per play, so the memoized notes are built in non-reduced mode while the animation then follows the reduce branch with the large fall distance, which parks the notes below the screen. Bogus property rain: the rain call sits in the id-mount effect, not in the getProperty success path.
